title: Cyrus and the Garden
author: Vesper Blackwood
blurb: Xanthe Amberdale, a bone-carver who hears the dead, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
